The Supervisor
Eventide Residential Aged Care
333 Glen Eira Road
Ripponlea, VIC. 3185

Dear Sir/Madam,
Re: Mrs Margaret (Maggie) Goldstein, aged 61
Mrs Goldstein was admitted to North Caulfield Private Hospital on 8 November 2016 with a dislocated right elbow due to a recent fall at your facility. She is now ready for discharge back into your care.
On admission, the dislocation was treated by our medical staff and her elbow has been stabilised in a cuff and sling. Currently she is using a wheelchair for mobility but needs some assistance with transfers. She also needs assistance with showering.
As you would be aware, although Mrs Goldstein is continent of bowel she is incontinent of bladder. Please note that during her stay in hospital she became reluctant to wear disposable briefs provided.
She is currently taking the following medications: Oxycodone 5mg 3 times a day (to be continued as needed); Atacand Plus 32/12.5 25mg once daily; and Remeron 15mg once daily. 
She is now medically stable. Her husband, Mr Goldstein, will collect her today to transfer her back to you.
Please monitor healing of her elbow and note the increased need for incontinence care. Please also be aware that a follow-up appointment has been made with a physiotherapist on 28/11/2016 at 2pm at Eventide.

Please contact me if you have any queries.
Yours sincerely,
Nurse
